name: silent_outcome_manipulation
description: Undetectable or insufficiently-detected changes that can flip outcomes.
notes: Prefer designs where attempts become loud via evidence.

name: verification_ecosystem_capture
description: The ecosystem that should detect/report problems is biased or suppressed so bad news is unseen or disbelieved.
notes: Treat the verification ecosystem itself as an attack surface.

name: irrecoverable_ambiguity
description: After the fact the public cannot reliably determine what happened (conflicts/missing evidence).
notes: Ambiguity is worse than a loud outage.

name: availability_failure
description: Known outages/delays where failure is obvious and provable.
notes: Prefer a loud failure to silent manipulation.

name: ux_imperfections
description: Confusing UX that does not change outcomes and is correctable without disputing evidence.
notes: Still worth fixing, but lower priority.
